risk_note: RV1 (contract, planned; D10-1287, change record 20261112 §3.4 D1, 05 F1-10k). Admin Agent trace query and AI report handling under tag admin-agent-traces: adminListAgentSessions and adminGetAgentSession (agent.trace; every successful detail read writes audit agent_trace_view; always the masked form, pii.* unmasks nothing; text null after the user's data is deleted, BR-AI-22; owner user_id or device_id, BR-AI-20), adminListAgentReports (agent.trace; deadline_at = reported_at + 48 hours, overdue = pending and now >= deadline_at, BR-ID-15), adminHandleAgentReport (agent.report, no step-up; note 1-500 characters after trim; pending -> handled with CAS, mismatch or already handled 20902 resource=agent_report; audit agent_report_handle). error-codes.yaml 20902 data.resource gains agent_report (catalog.test list updated, as CT-24zh / CT-24zv did). No new table: fields are main's agent_* columns and agent2's A1-A3 shapes. Host: codegen and the four route generators no drift, contracts:check 0, contracts-ts pass, rule tests 33/33, lint / format 0, tsc -b apps/api test apps/admin 0.

reviews.note: codex-run.sh review --review-type contract (D10-1075, medium). Round 2 over the increment: pass, no findings. couli-runs/CT-24zzi/review-contract-r1.json, review-contract-r2.json.
